name: fix-loader-agents-md
body: Amendment for agentic authoring, solution tier. Source statement: solution.component.template-library-loader's body stated the layout check accepts "only library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ at top level". Inconsistency: requirements.requirement.templates-dir-layout and requirements.requirement.templates-dir-validation were amended to permit exactly one inert non-template root entry, `AGENTS.md` (library-guide-layout), and requirements.requirement.library-guide-layout states the exception — an implementer following the loader's body would keep rejecting `AGENTS.md`, making init-library's load-cleanly AC unsatisfiable (feedback-2). Resolution [autonomous]: amended the loader's layout wording to mirror the amended templates-dir-validation step (2) and templates-dir-layout — the five documented entries plus the single permitted inert root entry `AGENTS.md` (library-guide-layout), never parsed, validated, rendered, listed or served; every other unknown top-level entry still errors naming the offending entry. Fail-fast ordering, file:line qualification and the theme/media reference checks are unchanged.
